## A manual scanner, and a way to watch for someone specific

The SCAN button used to be dead weight on the main screen — CLEAR *is* the scanner, so tapping it did nothing. Now it opens a picker: BLE or WIFI, each running a real focused sweep (not the continuous signature-matched scan, an unfiltered "everything nearby" pass) with a results list you can flip between without backing out, and a mini Squachy running the current background style behind him while it works.

Long-press any result and — after a confirm step, since this isn't something that should ever fire by accident — SquachWatch will watch that exact device or network and throw a dedicated full-screen alert the moment it comes back into range. Built for the AirTag-in-your-bag scenario, with one honest caveat: BLE addresses on modern hardware (AirTags included) can rotate specifically to defeat tracking-by-MAC, so treat this as "catches most things," not foolproof against a device deliberately trying to evade it.

Also new: deauthentication-flood detection (a burst of deauth frames, not just one — a single frame is normal WiFi traffic), folded into a new DEAUTH counter on the main screen, in the column freed up by combining AirTag/GTag/Tile into one TRACKER count.

### The actually-useful part
- **Added**: manual BLE/WiFi scanner via CLEAR's SCAN button, with a results list, mode switching, and Squachy's usual background style running behind him
- **Added**: watch a specific device or network from the scan results (long-press → confirm) and get a dedicated alert if it reappears
- **Added**: deauthentication-flood detection, rate-thresholded to avoid false alarms from normal disconnects
- **Changed**: AirTag/GTag/Tile counters combined into one TRACKER entry on the main screen to make room for DEAUTH
- **Fixed**: LOG screen rows where a long device/type name could smear into the line below it
- **Changed**: the hidden outfit-unlock gesture is now a 4-second hold on CLR instead of an 11-tap sequence that broke once SCAN stopped being a no-op
- **Fixed**: the title bar's settings/rotate icons are now reachable from the scan screen
- **Changed**: the first-boot walkthrough now advances on a tap anywhere, not just directly on the speech bubble
- **Changed**: list scroll direction inverted to match standard touch-scroll convention
